fuel_consumption.source_quote: Projections based on estimated consumption of four billion gallons and a price of $2.98 per gallon (2013 projected)

instrument_type_details.notes: Portfolio primarily option contracts: fixed price swaps, purchased calls, collars (sold put + purchased call), three-ways (sold put + purchased call + higher-strike sold call). Based on heating oil, diesel fuel, and crude oil. 1.2B gallons for 2013 (31%) and 63M gallons for 2014 (2%) hedged. 2013 sensitivity: at +20% fuel prices, hedge gain ~$0.08/gal; at -20% fuel prices, hedge loss ~$0.06/gal (modest hedge contribution). Fuel cost 36% of total operating expenses in 2012.
